# winrt-Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media.DXInterop

Sets the DXGI swap chain that a WinUI 3 `SwapChainPanel` shows, through the panel's native interfaces. It needs the Windows App Runtime, as WinUI 3 does, but works with any Windows App SDK release.

This package provides the `winrt.microsoft.ui.xaml.media.dxinterop` module.

```
pip install winrt-Microsoft.UI.Xaml.Media.DXInterop
```
